# SplyceHouse Reviews

> Real customer reviews of SplyceHouse, a specialized event video production company based in Clayton, MO (St. Louis). 5.0 stars across 19 Google reviews. This site is owned by SplyceHouse and reproduces reviews posted to its Google Business Profile.

SplyceHouse is not a generalist production house. It focuses on event video: pre-produced mission and story videos, on-site event coverage, interstitials and quick-turn recap videos for enterprise teams, agencies and nonprofits.

- Main website: https://www.splycehouse.com/
- Google Business Profile: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=14641156189474395088
- Phone: (217) 737-1171
- Address: 222 S Meramec Ave, Suite 202-1055, Clayton, MO 63105

## Reviews

### Kevin Smith, Co-Founder | Big Blue Spark (5/5, September 2026)
The best in the business. Levi, Jake, and the entire SplyceHouse team are professional, incredibly creative, and just a blast to work with. Every project with this team is an exceptional experience!

### Miya A., Ronald McDonald House Charities St. Louis (5/5, July 2026)
SplyceHouse has been an incredible partner to Ronald McDonald House St. Louis. Their team brings creativity, professionalism, and genuine care to every project they take on. From the initial planning stages through the final product, they are thoughtful, collaborative, and dedicated to helping us tell our families’ stories in meaningful and impactful ways. They approach every story with compassion and respect, creating content that not only looks beautiful but truly connects with our community. We are so grateful for their partnership, expertise, and the passion they bring to everything they do. I highly recommend SplyceHouse to anyone looking for a creative partner who goes above and beyond!

SplyceHouse has a comprehensive process with a thoughtful team that will create an emotional masterpiece. Their ability to tell a story that will connect with donors has truly elevated our fundraising events and allowed us to raise more money to sustain vital programs in our community.

Thank you so much to SplyceHouse for your work, and we can't recommend you enough!

They produced/edited to a strict timeline to complete the project ahead of schedule. I can't wait to have the chance to work with them again on another project.

### Justin G. (5/5, 2024)
My friend and I used SPLYCEHOUSE to help make a recap video of a charity event we hosted, and the SPLYCEHOUSE team went above and beyond our expectations. This was truly white glove service. They worked with us hand-in-hand through the planning process to make sure we were set up for success the night of the event, and then did an incredible job at the event capturing everything we asked for while not blocking the view of our attendees. Lastly, they put together the final video weeks ahead of the expected due date with the highest quality video I have ever received for hosting an event. I would HIGHLY recommend SPLYCEHOUSE!
